$comment: PB-27 — the VENDORED hash of every box config file a box reports (tooling/ops/boxes/post-config-manifest.sh),
read by tooling/ops/check-box-config-drift.mjs in ops-watch against platform_db.box_config_manifest.
`vendored` is the file's path inside the private corpus checkout; `sha256` is that file's hash, written ONLY by
`node tooling/ops/check-box-config-drift.mjs --refresh-vendored <corpus dir>` — never typed. A null `sha256` is
COVERAGE LOST (exit 2), never a pass. The logical names are the first column of each box's
/etc/nikatru/box-manifest.files; a file a box posts that is not declared here is a finding (UNDECLARED).
`maxPostAgeHours`: the box cron runs daily, so two missed runs plus slack.
